programmes.programName: Automatic Control, Bioengineering and Operations Research
programmes.school: Scuola di dottorato in Scienza e tecnologia dell’informazione e delle comunicazioni
programmes.department: Dipartimento di Ingegneria Informatica, Automatica e Gestionale Antonio Ruberti
programmes.evidence: Official 2026/27 Sapienza PhD course code 27736 explicitly includes Operations Research in the programme title and names it one of three actual curricula; university describes it as a PhD for original quantitative research.
limitations: Automatic Control and Bioengineering curricula are part of the same award; no additional doctorate counted for Operations Research curriculum.
The actual department title is Computer, Control and Management Engineering and is not itself a qualifying unit.

programmes.school: Scuola di dottorato in Scienze e tecnologie per l’innovazione industriale
programmes.department: Dipartimento di Ingegneria Meccanica e Aerospaziale
programmes.evidence: Official Sapienza 2026/27 course code 27738 names a PhD programme Industrial and Management Engineering, with current admission places and original research goals. This is distinct from course 27736.
limitations: The actual host is Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, which is not displayed as a qualifying Industrial Engineering department.
Do not count generic production or supply-chain research topics as extra programmes.

branches.conclusion: Central doctoral list includes Business Administration and Economics, but detailed doctoral named-field inventories not fully read.
Two current formally named qualifying doctorates verified by separate course codes; other plausible detailed technical doctoral fields remain to assess.
